Wild Area

Pokémon GO Wild Area 2026: Global

Sat, Nov 14, 2026, 10:00 AM → Sun, Nov 15, 2026, 6:00 PM (your local time: it happens at local time everywhere)

A worldwide weekend event (Nov 14–15, 10 a.m.–6 p.m. local). Free to join; an optional ticket adds extras.

COUNTDOWN & ADD TO CALENDAR

Featured Max Battles

  • Dynamax Dialga on Saturday, Dynamax Palkia on Sunday.

For everyone

  • GO Safari Balls from PokéStops and Gyms.
  • Up to three free Raid Passes a day from Gym discs.

With a ticket (US$11.99 in the web store)

  • A branching Special Research where you pick a Steel or Dragon path.
  • Better shiny odds and a higher daily Max Particle cap.
  • Incense can attract Latias and Latios.

Tip

The ticket only adds bonuses; you can play the weekend for free.
